purpose: Provider-neutral private inference boundary used by Raven role executions. This contract is not a public chat API.
security: The inference gateway owns provider selection and provider credentials.
Raven sends only the bounded inference packet and never receives raw provider credentials.
Base44 is not an allowed fallback transport or inference runtime.
Inference completion does not grant publication, deployment, purchase, payment, account mutation, or external-message authority.
Provider/model validation must not send mission or prompt text and must report inference_performed=false.

validation.purpose: Validate provider credential/model visibility through metadata endpoints before any inference prompt is sent.
